title: Sweep expired objects while preserving newest copies
statement: Repair the supplied implementation to satisfy this contract, preserving the public types and signature. Within each key, preserve exactly the record with largest modified timestamp, breaking ties in favor of the last input occurrence. Among all other records, remove those with modified < limit; retain those at or after the cutoff. Return removed record count, sum of removed sizes, and retained record count. The preserved newest record is retained even when expired.
constraints: key is nonnegative; modified may be negative; size is positive; duplicate records are distinct copies. modified is at least -1000000.
Use the exact declared Entry and Report record fields and solve signature. Return all three Report fields; do not mutate the caller's records.
All arithmetic fits signed int64; there are at most 30 records. limit is in [0, 30]. Return fresh results; no I/O, tests, exceptions, panic, or static-check bypasses.

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

struct Entry:
    key: int64
    modified: int64
    size: int64

struct Report:
    removed: int64
    reclaimed: int64
    retained: int64

function solve(view rows: list[Entry], limit: int64) returns Report

forbidden_patterns.message: Python type bypasses such as Any, casts, and ignored diagnostics are forbidden
raising exceptions is forbidden; return the documented report
TypeScript type bypasses such as any, suppressed diagnostics, and unchecked assertions are forbidden
throwing exceptions is forbidden; return the documented report
Go type erasure through any or interface{} is forbidden
panic is forbidden; return the documented report
unsafe Rust and unchecked type escapes are forbidden
panic is forbidden; return the documented report
